texts.caption:
National Hazing Prevention Week is almost here!

Join us September 21–25 for a week of education, awareness, and action as we come together to build a safer Highlander community. From educational webinars to Purple with a Purpose and our Pledge to Lead event, there are plenty of ways to get involved and take a stand against hazing.

📲 Check out the schedule and join us next week!

#NHPW2026 #LeadTheChangeUCR

Ready for a healing journey? 🧘‍♂️ Join us for a campus yoga session open to all UCR students, staff, and faculty!

📅 When: Mondays at 10:00 AM
🗓️ Dates: Oct 5, Oct 12, Oct 19, Oct 26, Nov 2, and Nov 9
📍Location: HUB 265
- All levels welcome: From beginners to advanced yogis.
- What to bring: Just yourself! (Feel free to bring your own mat if you prefer).

⚠️ Spaces are limited and registration is required! Scan the QR code or click the link in our bio to sign up.

registration Link: http://tinyurl.com/3644u8v2

📅 When: Mondays at 10:00 AM
🗓️ Dates: Oct 5, Oct 12, Oct 19, Oct 26, Nov 2, and Nov 9
📍Location: HUB 265
- All levels welcome: From beginners to advanced yogis.
- What to bring: Just yourself! (Feel free to bring your own mat if you prefer).

⚠️ Spaces are limited and registration is required! Scan the QR code or click the link in our bio to sign up.

registration Link: http://tinyurl.com/3644u8v2
